issues.reason: 'Sealing is finite-clause-only' is stated flatly ('A control verb with a to-infinitive never seals'), and the instruction set does supply a skeleton here — a prepositional verb's object is its preposition-named oblique, so '(Member sk_permission_1 permission)' + '(For sk_ask_1 sk_permission_1)' with the burn eventuality reified at top level, tenseless and status-free, per the noun's argument-PP rule — while this parse seals a non-finite complement under Theme, drops the requested object 'permission' entirely, and re-expresses it as a '(Permitted sk_burn_1)' status inside the seal.

Cardinality's value slot is specified as 'a native integer', and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure-family magnitude slots and the approximate clock-time value slot, so '(Cardinality sk_group_4 (ParticleFromNormal 12 1.2))' is ill-typed — and it breaks the hard-integer Compute test the counting-question machinery runs on a bound Cardinality.

This is the reviewer's own typicality-frame gap and every atom emitted there is true of the content; the instruction set's own 'room_temperature' precedent puts a fused circumstantial symbol in a NON-class slot while emitting its Inheritance genus ('(ConditionalProperty metal solid room_temperature)' + '(Inheritance room_temperature temperature)'), and the modifier-genus rule then mandates '(Inheritance normal_night normal)' because 'normal' is a gradable adjective predicable of the night — the incidental-description bar targets descriptive modifiers on referents whose members would otherwise be miscalled, not a circumstantial constant that has no members.

'Reserve the bare class symbol for a non-specific / generic object …, never for a specific definite individual' — 'The wintergloss' is the specific quantity just burned, and the definite-mass route ('the cake' -> '(Member sk_cake_1 cake)') shows the licensed encoding, so the kind symbol in '(Agent sk_repel_1 wintergloss)' puts a class in an individual role slot.

gaps_confirmed: 'ask X for permission to V': the For-oblique plus the noun's argument-PP machinery gives a skeleton, but nothing says how a deontic noun's INFINITIVAL complement attaches, nor how the permission relation reaches the requested act — the one thing the sentence is about.

An approximated count ('about twelve nightmoths'): Cardinality requires a native integer, CardinalityPhrase is for a numberless vague word, and CardinalityAtLeast/AtMost are bounds, so a hedged numeral count has no licensed carrier.
A typicality frame adverbial ('on a normal night') characterizing a habitual occasion: it is neither a calendar Time slot, an Every/TimesPer period or rate, nor a ConditionalProperty condition.

A definite anaphor whose antecedent was licensed as a bare kind filler ('burn wintergloss' … 'The wintergloss repelled …'): reusing the constant puts a class in an individual slot and minting a witness severs the coreference — the definite rule itself is clear, so what is missing is any way to link a definite back to a constant antecedent.
new_gaps: Coordinated date adjuncts on one clause ('hunted at the Sunken Cove on day 667, on day 668 and on day 669 of Year 2'): Coordination covers coordinated clauses, VPs and NPs, but nothing says whether coordinated temporal adjuncts give one event with several Time atoms (self-contradictory here) or one event per day, as this parse chose.

A re-lexicalized definite event noun naming a previously described eventuality ('the test', 'the result'): the event-anaphora rule covers only a pronoun pointing at a clause, so nothing identifies sk_test_1 with the burning it names — 'approved the test' and 'recorded the test' end up unconnected to the act they are about, and sk_result_1 unconnected to the count.
defect_summary: Request frame: the compliant form types and obliques the requested object — '(Member sk_permission_1 permission)' '(For sk_ask_1 sk_permission_1)' — and reifies the burn event at top level with its roles, Location and duration Measure but NO tense and NO status atom, with no seal and no '(Permitted sk_burn_1)'; how the permission relation reaches that act is the gap filed above. Hedged count: no licensed form exists for 'about twelve', so the compliant parse emits the group and the gather event without a count atom and records the gap, rather than typing a distribution into an integer slot. Definite mass: mint '(Member sk_wintergloss_1 wintergloss)' at the burning (a specific quantity taking part in that occurrence) and reuse it — '(Patient sk_burn_2 sk_wintergloss_1)', '(Agent sk_repel_1 sk_wintergloss_1)' — which both types the definite as an individual and keeps the coreference.
